attempts.summary: Deployed inventory-worker as a hardened systemd service on node1: dedicated unprivileged user/group, /var/lib/inventory data dir, a simple long-running tick loop, and a unit with NoNewPrivileges=yes plus ProtectSystem=strict/ReadWritePaths confinement to /var/lib/inventory (plus other standard sandboxing directives). Falsification test proved writes outside the allowed path fail (read-only) while writes inside succeed. Completed the mandatory single-node restart protocol: captured boot_id/service baseline, rebooted node1, confirmed boot_id changed, and verified the service came back enabled/active with persisted state.
